title: Garbage Disposals in San Antonio, TX
desc: Rosenberg Plumbing & Air provides garbage disposal repair and replacement in San Antonio, TX. Call today for fast service!

blocks.text: Garbage disposals have become an essential tool for many homeowners, helping prevent unpleasant food odors, and reduce the number of plastic trash bags you use too.

If you’re looking for experts in garbage disposal repair and replacement in San Antonio, TX, Rosenberg Plumbing & Air should be your first call. Whether your garbage disposal is jamming frequently or is struggling to keep up with the needs of your family, we can assist you.

Garbage disposals aren’t a new invention. They were invented almost 100 years ago, but the ones you can purchase today are more powerful, faster, quieter, and can even integrate with septic tanks so the food waste is sent to that tank rather than the drains.

items: Anti-jamming features to reverse the grinders if a jam is detected
Multiple grind settings to cope with hard foods
Connect to your septic tank if desired
Choose from a variety of depending on the size of your kitchen units

blocks.text: Most garbage disposers can be expected to work well for at least 8 to 10 years, or even longer if they have stainless steel grinders. If you have a unit that’s older than this and it’s started making odd noises when in use, or struggles to cope with certain foods, our garbage disposal replacement service could be the right choice.
